resolve_transient_placements runs on every layout (layout.rs:113). When transients are open it allocates a Vec (transient_portal_entries), a fresh HashSet (`active`) and a fresh FastHashSet (`layout_overlay_popups`) each pass. Keep reusable scratch buffers on WidgetTree (e.g. `transient_scratch: Vec<_>`, `active_scratch: HashSet<_>`, and refill `layout_overlay_popups` with `clear()` + `extend(...)`) and clear/refill them instead of re-collecting.

content_sensitivity() is called every frame (incular-runtime application.rs:1580 inside run_frame_at) and scans every element with no dirty flag. Cache the calculated policy in a WidgetTree field and mark it dirty only when an environment_override holding ContentSensitivity is mounted, unmounted or replaced (or keep a per-tree count of registered sensitivity scopes updated at those points), then return the cached value from content_sensitivity().

Use the lazy form so place_transient and root_layout_size() run only when no placement was recorded: `.copied().unwrap_or_else(|| RetainedTransientPlacement { desired_size: content_rect.size, result: place_transient(TransientPlacementInput { ... }) })`. Same result; the fallback is pure.
